section: Employment generation schemes - MGNREGA, PMEGP, DDU-GKY, PM-SVANidhi, Atmanirbhar packages
subsections: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages

accepted.s: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act was first proposed in 1991 by which of the following persons?
accepted.x: The National Rural Employment Guarantee legislation was first proposed in 1991 by P. V. Narasimha Rao.
accepted.tq: Use the person–proposal association rather than the later enactment date.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the initial implementation of the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act?
o: It began in 200 districts on 2 February 2006.
It began in 150 most backward districts in 2004.
It began in all districts on 1 April 2008.
It began in 625 districts on 2 October 2009.
accepted.x: The Act was launched on 2 February 2006 in 200 districts. The all-district coverage was achieved later, from 1 April 2008.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the initial coverage from later nationwide expansion.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the expansion of the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act:
1. An additional 130 districts were covered during 2007–08.
2. All districts were brought under the programme from 1 April 2008.
3. The programme initially covered 625 districts.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the programme initially covered 200 districts; 625 refers to later all-district coverage, not the initial launch.
accepted.tq: Split the statements by separating initial coverage from later expansion.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005, was passed in which month and year?
accepted.x: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act was passed in September 2005.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the enactment date from the launch and renaming dates.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: With effect from 1 July 2026, which legislation replaced the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act?
o: National Food for Work Programme Act, 2004
Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025
accepted.x: The Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025, replaced MGNREGA and came into force on 1 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official title in a scheme-renaming and replacement question.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, the guaranteed wage employment and the period over which the programme is operated are respectively:
accepted.x: VB-G RAM G provides 125 days of employment per household and operates over 305 days.
accepted.tq: Compare the paired numerical features instead of recalling either number in isolation.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025?
o: Funding pattern — Entirely demand-driven Central funding
Seasonal pause — States may pause works for up to 60 days during sowing and harvest
Wage payment — Only once at the end of the financial year
accepted.x: States may pause works for up to 60 days during sowing and harvest. VB-G RAM G has a 60:40 funding pattern, a 9 per cent administrative cost ceiling and weekly or fortnightly wage payment.
accepted.tq: Find the one correctly matched feature among swapped policy provisions.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The funding pattern under the VB-G RAM G Act is correctly stated as:
o: Entirely financed by the Central Government
50:50 between Centre and States in all regions
60:40 between Centre and States, with 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and Union Territories
90:10 between Centre and States in all States
accepted.x: The general funding pattern is 60:40, while the ratio is 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and Union Territories.
accepted.tq: Check the general ratio and its stated regional exception.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four priority areas of works under VB-G RAM G?
accepted.x: The four priority areas are water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood infrastructure, and extreme-weather or disaster-related works. Urban metro-rail development is not included.
accepted.tq: Eliminate the option outside the specified four-category framework.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the additional provisions of VB-G RAM G is correct?
o: Contractors are made compulsory for all works.
The statutory wage floor is fixed at ₹250 per day.
Job cards are renamed Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards.
Assets are recorded only in NREGASoft.
accepted.x: Under VB-G RAM G, job cards become Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards. The Act prohibits contractors, places assets on the VB-NRIS stack and specifies a statutory wage floor of ₹300 per day.
accepted.tq: Use exact terminology to distinguish renamed instruments from existing systems.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under MGNREGA, the unit to which the employment guarantee is attached is:
o: Each adult individual in a rural area
Each registered worker in a Gram Panchayat
accepted.x: The entitlement under MGNREGA is provided to a household, not separately to every individual adult.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the household-based entitlement and an individual-based interpretation.

accepted.s: Which provision of the Constitution is associated with the right to work that provides the Directive Principles basis for MGNREGA?
accepted.x: MGNREGA is anchored in Article 41, which relates to the right to work, education and public assistance in certain cases.
accepted.tq: Match the policy objective with the relevant constitutional article.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the target group and objectives of MGNREGA:
1. It covers rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
2. It seeks to reduce distress migration.
3. It is primarily intended for urban skilled workers.
4. It includes natural resource management and durable asset creation among its objectives.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1, 2 and 4 are correct. Statement 3 is false because MGNREGA targets rural households volunteering for unskilled manual work, not urban skilled workers.
accepted.tq: Identify the target group first, then test the associated objectives.

accepted.s: Which Ministry is the nodal Ministry for MGNREGA?
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
accepted.x: MGNREGA is administered by the Ministry of Rural Development.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry–scheme association and avoid neighbouring ministry substitutions.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement regarding wages under MGNREGA is correct?
o: The wage is fixed by Gram Sabhas and paid after one financial year.
The wage is State-specific and notified, and payment is made through Aadhaar-linked accounts by DBT.
The wage is determined by the World Bank and credited to any unregistered account.
The wage is uniform throughout India and is paid only in cash.
accepted.x: MGNREGA wages are State-specific and notified. They are transferred through DBT to Aadhaar-linked accounts.
accepted.tq: Ask who fixes the wage and how the payment is transferred.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Wages under MGNREGA are required to be paid within how many days of the work done?
accepted.x: MGNREGA wages are to be paid within 15 days of the work done. Delay attracts compensation.
accepted.tq: Use the precise statutory time limit rather than the broader idea of timely payment.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What is the minimum share of women prescribed among MGNREGA beneficiaries?
accepted.x: At least one-third of MGNREGA beneficiaries must be women, although their actual share has consistently exceeded 50 per cent of person-days.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the statutory minimum from the actual participation trend.

accepted.s: Which pair is correctly matched in the context of MGNREGA monitoring?
o: Bhuvan — GeoMGNREGA geo-tagging platform; NREGASoft — Management Information System
Bhuvan — Wage payment authority; NREGASoft — Social audit forum
GeoMGNREGA — Constitutional provision; NREGASoft — Central Finance Commission
NREGASoft — Satellite launch vehicle; Bhuvan — Unemployment allowance portal
accepted.x: Bhuvan, developed by ISRO, supports GeoMGNREGA geo-tagging, while NREGASoft is the programme's Management Information System.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure technology–function pair and reject swapped institutional roles.

accepted.s: Social audit of MGNREGA works is mandatory and is conducted by:
accepted.x: Social audit is mandatory under MGNREGA and is conducted by the Gram Sabha. Gram Sabhas also plan and monitor works.
accepted.tq: Identify the local participatory body responsible for the function.

accepted.s: If employment is not provided within 15 days of an application under MGNREGA, the unemployment allowance is at least:
o: One-fourth of the wage throughout the period
One-fourth of the wage for the first 30 days and one-half thereafter
One-half of the wage for the first 30 days and one-fourth thereafter
The full wage for the first 30 days and one-half thereafter
accepted.x: The unemployment allowance is at least one-fourth of the wage for the first 30 days and one-half thereafter.
accepted.tq: Track the change in rate after the first 30-day period.

accepted.s: Which of the following is an example of convergence under MGNREGA?
o: Replacing Gram Sabha monitoring with private contractors
Providing urban metro employment through the PMRY portal
Providing 90 or 95 person-days to PMAY-G beneficiaries through the AwaasSoft–NREGASoft link
Transferring all MGNREGA works to the Ministry of Commerce
accepted.x: MGNREGA converges with PMAY-G by providing 90 or 95 person-days to eligible beneficiaries through the AwaasSoft–NREGASoft link.
accepted.tq: Recognise convergence from the linked scheme and digital platform.

accepted.s: The annual scale of MGNREGA is broadly represented by which of the following ranges?
accepted.x: The broad annual scale is about 5–6 crore households and 200–250 crore person-days.
accepted.tq: Match the two related scale indicators rather than selecting an isolated figure.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is classified as a self-employment programme rather than a wage-employment programme?
accepted.x: PMEGP is a self-employment programme. NREP, SGRY and NFFWP are wage-employment programmes.
accepted.tq: Separate programmes by the nature of employment created, not by their rural focus.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. NREP — Wage employment
2. IRDP — Self-employment
3. MGNREGS — Wage employment
4. NRLM — Wage employment
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: NREP and MGNREGS are wage-employment programmes, while IRDP is a self-employment programme. NRLM belongs to the self-employment group, so pair 4 is incorrect.
accepted.tq: Classify each programme before checking the coded combination.

accepted.s: PMRY, introduced in 1993, was primarily intended for:
accepted.x: The Prime Minister's Rozgar Yojana, or PMRY, was intended for educated unemployed youth and was a self-employment programme.
accepted.tq: Link the scheme acronym with its distinctive target group.

accepted.s: The Food for Work Programme was started in 1977 during the government led by:
accepted.x: The Food for Work Programme was started in 1977 by the Janata government.
accepted.tq: Use the year–government association while distinguishing it from NFFWP.

accepted.s: The National Food for Work Programme was launched on 14 November 2004 in:
o: All 200 districts covered initially by NREGA
accepted.x: NFFWP was launched on 14 November 2004 in the 150 most backward districts.
accepted.tq: Retain both the launch date and the precise district count.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between NFFWP, SGRY and NREGA?
o: NFFWP and SGRY were created after NREGA in 2009.
NFFWP and SGRY were subsumed into NREGA in its districts from 2006.
Only SGRY was subsumed into NFFWP in 2010.
NREGA was subsumed into SGRY in 2004.
accepted.x: NFFWP and SGRY were subsumed into NREGA in the districts covered by NREGA from 2006. The 2009 event was the addition of the name Mahatma Gandhi, not the merger of NFFWP.
accepted.tq: Use the sequence of predecessor programmes and avoid the renaming-year trap.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following employment programmes in chronological order of their introduction:
A. Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme
B. Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas
C. Jawahar Rozgar Yojana
D. Employment Assurance Scheme
accepted.x: DWCRA was introduced in 1982, RLEGP in 1983, JRY in 1989 and EAS in 1993. Therefore, the correct order is B, A, C, D.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest items first, then place the two middle programmes.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Programme)
a. IRDP
b. NREP
c. DWCRA
d. RLEGP

List-II (Year)
i. 1982
ii. 1978–79
iii. 1980
iv. 1983

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: IRDP dates from 1978–79, NREP from 1980, DWCRA from 1982 and RLEGP from 1983.
accepted.tq: Start from the distinctive year associations and eliminate codes with a swapped pair.

accepted.s: IRDP was extended to all development blocks on:
accepted.x: IRDP was introduced in 1978–79 and extended to all development blocks on 2 October 1980.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the programme's initial year from the later nationwide block coverage date.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: SGRY was introduced in 2001. JRY dates from 1989, SGSY/JGSY from 1 April 1999, and NFFWP from 2004.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched year after checking the neighbouring programme dates.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the chronological position of NREGA and VB-G RAM G in the employment-programme sequence?
o: NREGA — 2006; VB-G RAM G — 2025 Act, in force from 1 July 2026
NREGA — 1999; VB-G RAM G — 2025 Act, in force from 1 April 2026
accepted.x: NREGA dates from 2006. VB-G RAM G is a 2025 Act that came into force on 1 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the year of enactment from the later date on which the legislation came into force.

accepted.s: The World Development Report 2014 described MGNREGA as a:
accepted.x: The World Bank's World Development Report 2014 called MGNREGA a “stellar example of rural development.”
accepted.tq: Recall the distinctive evaluative phrase and its institutional source.
accepted.sec: MGNREGA - Act, launch, phases, renaming, entitlement, wages  [APPSC]
